g_meas_info.rule: sum n_gapfilled_supported / sum n_gapfilled over the prior run's tune-half rows (status ok)

interpretation: eligibility = ratio of tune-half medians (all strata, n1 included) of total exchange flux and of gene-backed flux, each within 10% of the shipped arm's; every arm optimal and at the 0.95 floor on every row

G is read per (P, C, X) family on the n >= 2 rows where the gapfilled-flux FACE MIDPOINT differs across G's levels by > 1e-6 x max(1, D); stratum weights renormalised over strata with such rows; ties -> G0
selection across families on all tune rows of the n >= 2 strata, pooling A; ties within 0.002 -> fewest departures, then lowest A
headroom captured relative to the selected cell's own two_tier and oracle; the shipped-cell version beside it
when P = kn is selected, the shuffled comparator is est_shuffled at the same cell, flagged (the design has no kn-shuffled arm)

meta.clade_rank_rule: family -> order; start at family, back off one rank while the anchor's clade (anchor = reps[0]) has < 3 genomes in the fold reference (_cache_ec_subset keys) or its panel label is a placeholder ('unclassified_*'); none admissible -> clade null, alpha 0

derived_from.change: isotonic map removed: Stage O carries E3, not E4(E3). E4 vs E3 universe Brier -0.0003 [-0.0007, 0.0001] and union Brier -0.0005 [-0.0024, 0.0010] cover 0, macro F1 -0.0042 [-0.0067, -0.0017]; the map is fitted on all five folds (in-sample for these 360 amplicons), on per-EC values (applied at role level it extrapolates), and caps p at 0.943 so no reaction reaches the cost floor.
